VERIFIED: n/a (no verified claims)
NOT VERIFIED: FINMA approved Switzerland's first bitcoin ETF — FINMA approval notice or decision not obtained; immediate official-source search was blocked.; ETF issuer disclosure not disclosed by FINMA — Primary FINMA documentation identifying the fund and issuer is missing.; FINMA approved exemption ETFs holding only bitcoin — Official exemption text and scope not obtained.

• Economic effect: The issuer is undisclosed in the report; launch timing, subscriptions and actual bitcoin purchases are not established, so economic impact is not estimable.
• Token capture: BTC UNKNOWN — Reported bitcoin ETF approval enables a bitcoin investment wrapper; subscriptions could create underlying demand, but holdings, replication method and flows are unknown. — The immediate official-source search was blocked, and incomplete market coverage leaves the current reaction unresolved.
